answer: Grade-correlation discount. Track every pair of graders that share panels. If two identities agree on 19 of their last 20 shared seals while the network-wide agreement rate is about 70%, both seal weights are halved and the pair is flagged for audit. A sybil farm has to vote as one bloc to steer a jury, so its keys form an island of identical scores on a mesa of normal disagreement. Each added clone is one more ember in the pattern, so scale makes the farm easier to see, not stronger.
